assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, mouse gastrocnemius (S2.24.p1), RSEM expected counts on GRCm38 v91 (S2.24.p2)
sample_inclusion: 23-mo-old mice after a 10-wk HIMIT intervention started at 20 mo: WT untrained, WT trained, G6PD-Tg untrained; both sexes (S1.p1, S2.2.p1). GEO deposits 5 per group per sex = 30 samples (subset of the 61 mice phenotyped).
primary_estimand: Effect of 10-wk late-onset HIMIT exercise training on gastrocnemius gene expression in old (23 mo) WT mice: WT trained vs WT untrained (Fig. 2H comparison; S1.p7).
planned_contrasts: WT trained vs WT untrained (exercise effect; S1.p7, Fig. 2H; paper gives no DEG count in the text, results in Dataset S2 / SI Fig. S2E)
G6PD-Tg untrained vs WT untrained (transgene/robustness effect, not exercise; S1.p7, Fig. 2I)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one gastrocnemius sample per independent mouse
normalization: genes < 10 CPM filtered; expected counts TMM-normalised with edgeR (S2.24.p2)
paper_method: limma v3.50.3 on TMM-normalised RSEM expected counts (S2.24.p2); GSEA (clusterProfiler/DOSE, MitoCarta 3.0) at FDR q < 0.25 (S2.26.p3)
sex_handling: S2.26.p2: 'Sexes were analyzed separately' (general statistics statement; RNA-seq section does not say whether DE pooled sexes)

paper_threshold.note: no DEG threshold stated for RNA-seq; only GSEA FDR q < 0.25 (S2.26.p3)

paper_results: No DEG count or named DEG list in the main text; RNA-seq reported as GSEA of OxPhos, cristae formation, ROS detoxification and glutathione metabolism upregulated in trained and G6PD-Tg groups (S1.p7).
